description: This Scala source file defines the SparkConnectStreamingQueryListenerHandler class, which manages long-running streaming query listener events within Apache Spark's SQL connect module. It handles adding and removing server-side listeners, sending responses via gRPC, and logging relevant events.

classes.name: SparkConnectStreamingQueryListenerHandler
classes.description: Handles long-running streaming query listener events, including adding and removing server-side listeners, and communicates via gRPC.

methods.name: handleListenerCommand
methods.description: Processes streaming query listener commands to add or remove listeners, manages responses, and logs events.
